league_audio.name: MLB.TV / MLB app audio
league_audio.what: MLB.TV subscribers can watch or listen to audio of every out-of-market regular-season game live (home/away radio feeds) in the MLB app; in-market blackouts apply to video.

league_audio.name: ESPN Radio (MLB Postseason national radio)
league_audio.what: ESPN Radio is the national radio broadcaster of the 2026 MLB Postseason: MLB's official schedule data lists 'ESPN Radio' (isNational=true) on all 2026 postseason games scheduled Sept 29 - Oct 12 (Wild Card Series, Division Series and LCS games), alongside each club's local flagship. World Series games were not yet in the data checked.

league_audio.name: Team flagship radio apps
league_audio.what: Several flagships stream games in-territory for free (e.g. Seattle Sports 710 app, AM830 app for Angels in English/Spanish, A's Cast); streaming rights vary by club.
